suppress.notes: Spring Framework 6.2.19 (latest OSS release of the 6.2 line; fixes only in 7.0.x). Affected components not used by the application: XsltView, views/FreeMarker, Server-Sent Events, WebFlux (Aalto XML, functional endpoints, PartEventHttpMessageReader, Jetty, WebSocket), RSocket, evaluation of user-supplied SpEL, UrlHandlerFilter, UrlFileNameViewController, Content-Disposition from untrusted input and data binding of user-supplied property paths (@ModelAttribute/DataBinder; the API only uses @RequestBody/Jackson).

Spring Security 6.5.11 (latest OSS release of the 6.5 line). Affected components not used: embedded LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer), DPoP, WebAuthn and AesBytesEncryptor. CVE-2026-59276 (non-constant-time comparison): the application compares passwords with BCrypt (PasswordEncoder.matches) and validates JWTs by their HMAC signature (Nimbus); CSRF, remember-me and sessions are disabled. Residual risk accepted until the migration to Spring Security 7.
Spring Data JPA 3.5.13 (latest of the 2025.0 line). CVE-2026-47834 requires a Sort coming from untrusted input; the application only uses Sorts fixed in code (openedAt, name, licensePlate).
